description: Read a household's pantry and plan as plain text for the AI member of its OpenVibe.Chat room (Chat's AI members, linked to a Food household): GET /internal/households/:planId/chat-context → { text, source, updated_at }. The household is a saved plan shared with its members; the text names the members by display name, the plan's days and meals, what is still to buy and what each member keeps in their cupboard. Loopback only, service token; granted to Chat.
